productIntent.goal: AI-native, modular, industry-agnostic Enterprise Operating System where enterprise activity can be executed, explained, replayed, upgraded, and continuously evolved.

currentStage.name: Enterprise Economic Loops
currentStage.businessGoal: Prove complete real enterprise business loops on top of the certified Economic Runtime.

activeRequirementSet.name: Sales Return / Exchange / Refund / Red Invoice Reference Loop
acceptance: sales return appends canonical BusinessData and explicitly identifies its source
sales return restores Inventory quantity and replayable value
sales exchange appends canonical BusinessData and explicitly identifies original/return source
exchange expresses replacement movement through normal business facts without mutating original history
customer refund appends canonical BusinessData and decreases Cash
refund explicitly identifies original receipt and/or return source
red invoice appends canonical BusinessData and explicitly identifies original invoice/sales economic source
red invoice does not mutate or delete original invoice/business history
financial reversal from red invoice is expressed through explicit posting rules where applicable
reverse-flow completion is not inferred merely from matching quantities/amounts
relevant Work state closes from derived balance/projection state
Full Replay rebuilds identical official reverse-flow economic state
Full Replay does not execute Commands again
verified: formal post-EEL-C02 alignment selected reverse-flow business coverage
enterprise-core-v1 already defines sales-return transaction/application and inventory/receivable posting intent
existing BusinessData, Posting, Ledger, Relation, WorkProjection and Replay primitives are preferred before new abstractions
deferred: RMA/after-sales platformization beyond the simple exchange event
tax-control integration and complex statutory tax calculation beyond the simple red-invoice event

antiOverdesignQuestions: Which confirmed current requirement needs this?
What acceptance gate is blocked if we do not build it now?
Can an existing mechanism satisfy the need more simply?
Is this current necessity or mainly hypothetical future flexibility?
alignmentTriggers: every 3 completed verified work packets since last alignment
proposal to generalize a local mechanism

lastAlignment.reason: EEL-C02 completed and mandatory completed-loop requirement-alignment trigger fired.
lastAlignment.result: Final goal and Stage E objective remain unchanged. EEL-C03 now includes sales return, exchange, customer refund, and red invoice as simple append-only business events; platformization (RMA/tax-control) remains deferred.

alignmentCadence.countingRule: Count merged bounded slices whose evidence level is DATABASE E2E VERIFIED or CERTIFIED.
alignmentCadence.triggerRule: Run formal alignment at the third slice or any mandatory event trigger, whichever comes first.
alignmentCadence.resetRule: Reset the slice counter after a formal alignment review is recorded in lastAlignment.

nextRequirementSelection.selection: EEL-C03 Sales Return / Exchange / Refund / Red Invoice Reference Loop
nextRequirementSelection.rule: Treat exchange and red invoice as simple canonical events first; do not conflate them with RMA, credit-memo platforms, tax-control integrations, or generic reversal engines unless current acceptance requires those.
